methodologyNotes: Roster covers twelve household grain mills spanning high-speed impact mills (NutriMill Classic, WonderMill Electric, Blendtec Kitchen Mill), stone-burr mills (Mockmill 100/200, KoMo Classic, KoMo Fidibus 21, NutriMill Harvest, hawos Easy), and hand-crank mills (Victorio VKP1024, Country Living Grain Mill, WonderMill Junior Deluxe+), verified 2026-08-05 against manufacturer/importer product pages (NutriMill, Mockmill, WonderMill, KoMo/komo.bio, hawos via Loewen META, Blendtec) and authorized-dealer retail pages (Breadtopia, Pleasant Hill Grain, Plant Based Pros, Nutrition Lifestyles, Harvest Essentials, Pantry Paratus, Everything Kitchens, Good4LifeMart) where the manufacturer itself does not sell direct or publish consumer pricing. Grinding capacity is reported in each manufacturer's own published unit (cups/min, oz/min, or g/min of flour, or lb/hr where a source states it directly) rather than force-converted to a single lb/hr figure, because flour yield per cup/oz varies by grain type and no source publishes the density conversion needed to do that accurately without guessing. No verifiable manufacturer- or retailer-hosted product image URL could be confirmed as directly resolvable during this research pass, so the optional image field is omitted for every entry rather than guessed. Noise level in dB is not published by any of these manufacturers (several use qualitative marketing language like "whisper quiet" instead, which is preserved as free text where present); left null where no such claim exists. accessedAt 2026-08-05 throughout.

products.name: NutriMill Classic Electric Grain Mill (Model 760200)
products.priceNote: Official price on nutrimill.com; frequently discounted elsewhere (Walmart Business ~$279.95-$299, Knife Merchant lower still) — $329 used as the manufacturer's own list price.

specs.Texture adjustment range: Fine pastry flour to coarse cracked grain, via motor speed and texture control knobs
specs.Noise level: Marketed as "Whisper Quiet", described by NutriMill as comparable to a vacuum cleaner; no dB figure published
specs.Dimensions: 12 in W x 12 in D x 13 in H
specs.Warranty: 5-year limited warranty; lifetime warranty on motor and milling heads

products.provenance: NutriMill's own product page confirms the 1200W motor, 20-cup flour bowl / 12-cup hopper, 12x12x13 in. dimensions, 5-cup/min fine-flour rate, and 5-year limited warranty with lifetime motor/milling-head coverage. Price ($329) is NutriMill's own listed figure; third-party retailers (Walmart Business, Knife Merchant) show lower current street prices.

products.name: NutriMill Harvest Electric Stone Grain Mill
products.priceNote: Official price on nutrimill.com; some retailers (Lehman's, Everything Kitchens) list this model around $549-$599.

specs.Texture adjustment range: Fine pastry flour to coarse cracked grain, via smooth-feel texture adjustment knob
specs.Noise level: Marketed as "whisper-quiet", though user reviews describe noise closer to a blender crushing ice; no dB figure published
specs.Dimensions: 7 in W x 7 in D x 13 in H (bamboo housing); weight 18.7 lb

products.provenance: NutriMill's own product page confirms the 450W motor, bamboo housing with corundum stones, 18.7 lb assembled weight, and 5-year warranty. No manufacturer-published grinding rate (cups/min or lb/hr) or hopper volume was found on the fetched page, so both are left null rather than estimated. Price is NutriMill's own current listing; Lehman's and other resellers show a higher figure, likely a stale/pre-discount price.

products.name: Mockmill 100 Stone Grain Mill
products.priceNote: Breadtopia authorized-dealer retail price; Mockmill (Wolfgang Mock GmbH) does not sell direct to US consumers and distributes only through retail partners.

specs.Texture adjustment range: Extremely fine flour to coarse cracked grain, via stepless lever adjustment
specs.Dimensions: 15 in x 8.7 in x 7.5 in; weight 13.22 lb

products.provenance: Breadtopia's product page (an authorized Mockmill US retailer) confirms the $380 price, 360W (1/2 hp) motor, 90mm corundum-ceramic millstones, 2 lb 7 oz hopper, 15 x 8.7 x 7.5 in. dimensions, 13.22 lb weight, and 6-year non-commercial warranty. Made in Germany, per manufacturer materials.

products.name: Mockmill 200 Professional Grain Mill
products.priceNote: Breadtopia authorized-dealer retail price for the Mockmill Professional 200.

specs.Texture adjustment range: Extremely fine flour to coarse cracked grain, via rotating hopper adjustment
specs.Dimensions: 15 in H x 9.5 in D x 8 in W; weight 20.7 lb
specs.Warranty: 2 years for commercial/industrial use; 12 years for private/home use

products.provenance: Breadtopia's product page confirms the $890 price, 600W (3/4 hp) motor, Arboblend (liquid-wood) housing, 200g/min fine-flour rate, 2.8 lb hopper, 15 x 9.5 x 8 in. dimensions, 20.7 lb weight, and the split commercial/home warranty terms.

products.name: WonderMill Electric Grain Mill
products.priceNote: Everything Kitchens retail price; thewondermill.com routes purchases to authorized retailers and does not display its own consumer price.

specs.Grinding capacity (lb/hr): over 100 lb flour/hr; 12 cups fine flour in ~3 min (per WonderMill)
specs.Texture adjustment range: Super-fine flour to coarser meal, via adjustment knob
specs.Burr type (stone/steel/impact): impact (stainless steel "micronizing"/Microburst fins, not a traditional burr mill)

products.provenance: Pleasant Hill Grain's product page and WonderMill's own site (thewondermill.com) together confirm the 1250W motor ("most powerful of the micronizing mills"), >100 lb/hr flour rate, 12-cup-in-3-minutes claim, 8-cup hopper / 16-cup flour bowl, and limited lifetime warranty. Price sourced from Everything Kitchens as thewondermill.com does not display its own price. No manufacturer-published exterior dimensions were located, so Dimensions is left null.

products.name: KoMo Classic Electric Grain Mill (Fidibus Classic)
products.priceNote: Nutrition Lifestyles retail price (listing was out of stock at time of check but price displayed); other retailers (Plant Based Pros) price the related KoMo Medium mill around $459, illustrating spread across the KoMo line.

products.priceNote: Plant Based Pros retail price; Pleasant Hill Grain periodically offers this model on clearance at a lower price.

specs.Grinding capacity (lb/hr): 5-6 oz bread-texture flour/min (up to 100 g/min at finest setting)
specs.Texture adjustment range: Fine to coarse, via adjustment knob
specs.Dimensions: 7.25 in W x 8.5 in D x 13.5 in H; weight 14.5 lb

products.name: Victorio VKP1024 Deluxe Grain Mill
products.priceNote: Harvest Essentials retail price for the base hand-crank unit. The optional VKP1024-M electric drive motor (120V, 90W, 50 RPM) is sold separately, typically $50-60.

specs.Texture adjustment range: Coarse to fine, via adjustment screw
specs.Hopper capacity: large-capacity hopper (exact volume not published by manufacturer)

products.provenance: Harvest Essentials' product page confirms the $120 price, hand-crank operation grinding ~1/4 cup flour/min, stainless steel burrs adjustable coarse to fine, and 2-year limited warranty. The base VKP1024 ships without a motor; the optional VKP1024-M electric motor accessory (120VAC/60Hz, 0.75A, 90W, 50 RPM) is documented separately on Amazon and Walmart listings and is not included in this entry's price or motor-power spec, which reflects the base hand-crank unit (0W).

products.name: Country Living Grain Mill
products.priceNote: List price commonly cited across authorized dealers (Pleasant Hill Grain, Homestead Gristmill); the manufacturer's own site (countrylivinggrainmills.com) does not display price without a dealer/account login.

specs.Grinding capacity (lb/hr): 1 cup wheat flour per ~1.25 min (hand crank)
specs.Texture adjustment range: Fine to coarse, via adjustable burr plates
specs.Burr type (stone/steel/impact): steel (precision-engineered high-carbon steel burrs, 5 in diameter)
specs.Dimensions: 15 in H; 12 in flywheel, 8 in handle

products.provenance: Pleasant Hill Grain's dealer listing and the manufacturer's own site (countrylivinggrainmills.com) together confirm the hand-crank-only design, 2 lb hopper, 15 in. height, 12 in. flywheel, 5 in. diameter high-carbon steel burrs, ~1 cup flour per 1.25 min output, and lifetime warranty. The unit ships without a motor; its flywheel can be adapted to an optional motorizing kit sold separately, so motor power is recorded as 0W for the base hand-crank configuration. countrylivinggrainmills.com requires a dealer login to display price, so the widely-cited $765 dealer list price is used.

products.name: Blendtec Kitchen Mill (K-Tec)
products.priceNote: Retail price per Good4LifeMart, matching Blendtec's own cited MSRP; Blendtec markets this product under its legacy K-Tec Kitchen Mill branding.

specs.Grinding capacity (lb/hr): up to 1 lb grain/min (per manufacturer); 24 cups flour in under 8 min
specs.Burr type (stone/steel/impact): impact (stainless steel Micronetic milling chamber, not a traditional burr mill)
specs.Dimensions: 9.25 in x 10.25 in x 8.50 in; weight 8 lb

products.provenance: Good4LifeMart's product page and the Amazon K-Tec Kitchen Mill listing together confirm the 1.8 hp / 1000W motor, patented stainless-steel Micronetic milling chamber, 15-cup polycarbonate milling pan, 1 lb/min grinding rate, 24-cups-in-under-8-minutes claim, 8 lb weight, and 8-year warranty. No adjustable texture-control mechanism is documented for this model (fixed micronizing action), so Texture adjustment range is left null rather than assumed.

products.name: hawos Easy Grain Mill
products.priceNote: Loewen META (US importer/distributor for hawos, made in Germany) retail price for the 110V US-spec unit; hawos does not sell direct to US consumers.

specs.Grinding capacity (lb/hr): 3.5 oz/min at fine setting, up to 8.8 oz/min at coarse setting
specs.Texture adjustment range: Fine flour to coarse, via adjustment dial
specs.Dimensions: 5.9 in x 5.9 in x 13.0 in; weight 17.4 lb

products.name: WonderMill Junior Deluxe+ Hand Grain Mill
products.priceNote: Pantry Paratus current sale price (list price $379.95).

specs.Texture adjustment range: Fine to coarse, via lockable adjustment knob
specs.Burr type (stone/steel/impact): stone/steel (dual burr set included: stone burrs for dry grains, stainless steel burrs for oily/wet items and nut butters)
